hints: A column can say what value to use when nobody gives one. Think about where that rule belongs: in each INSERT, or in the column itself?
The likely mistake is fixing only the new row. The teams that already existed need the value too, and adding the column is the moment Postgres fills them in.
solution_explanation: DEFAULT false tells Postgres what to store when an INSERT leaves is_public out, and adding a column with a default also fills that value into every existing row. NOT NULL makes the database refuse a team with no answer at all, so the rule can't be skipped later.
